headline.text: Election Night at a glance

items.text: 5:30 p.m. ET: Exit polls start arriving.
6 p.m. ET: First polls close in Indiana.
7 p.m. ET: Polls start closing in Florida, Georgia and Virginia.
7:30 p.m. ET: Polls close in North Carolina and Ohio.
8 p.m. ET: Polls close in Illinois, Maryland, Rhode Island, New Jersey, Pennsylvania, New Hampshire and Washington, D.C.
9 p.m. ET: Polls close in Michigan, Colorado, Kansas, Minnesota, Arizona, Wisconsin and Texas.
